Bleeding (Piercing).name: Bleeding (Piercing)
Bleeding (Piercing).description: A @Condition[bleeding] (Piercing) creature suffers additional Piercing damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Bleeding (Slashing).name: Bleeding (Slashing)
Bleeding (Slashing).description: A @Condition[bleeding] creature suffers additional Slashing damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Burning.name: Burning
Burning.description: A @Condition[burning] creature suffers additional Fire damage to both @Rule[resource.health] and @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Confused.name: Confused
Confused.description: A @Condition[confused] creature suffers Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of each turn, and is also treated as @Condition[disoriented].

Corroding.name: Corroding
Corroding.description: A @Condition[corroding] creature suffers additional Acid damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Decaying.name: Decaying
Decaying.description: A @Condition[decaying] creature suffers additional Corruption damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Dominated.name: Dominated
Dominated.description: A @Condition[dominated] creature suffers Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of each turn.

Entropy.name: Entropy
Entropy.description: A creature afflicted with @Condition[entropy] suffers Void damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of each turn, and is also treated as @Condition[frightened].

Freezing.name: Freezing
Freezing.description: A @Condition[freezing] creature suffers additional Cold damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Inspired.name: Inspired
Inspired.description: A creature that is @Condition[inspired] will gradually recover @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of each of its turns.

Irradiated.name: Irradiated
Irradiated.description: An @Condition[irradiated] creature suffers additional Radiant damage to both @Rule[resource.health] and @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Mending.name: Mending
Mending.description: A creature that is @Condition[mending] will gradually recover @Rule[resource.health] at the start of each of its turns.

Poisoned.name: Poisoned
Poisoned.description: A @Condition[poisoned] creature suffers additional Poison damage to @Rule[resource.health] at the start of its subsequent turns.

Shocked.name: Shocked
Shocked.description: A @Condition[shocked] creature suffers Electricity damage to @Rule[resource.morale] at the start of each turn.

Suffocating.name: Suffocating
Suffocating.description: A @Condition[suffocating] creature suffers Void damage to both @Rule[resource.wounds] and @Rule[resource.madness] at the start of each turn, representing physical lung trauma and panic from being deprived of breathable air. While Suffocating, a creature is also @Condition[silenced].
